description: Climate, visual settings, and natural spawn rules for a native custom biome.

downfall.description: Humidity from zero to one. Defaults to 0.5.

fog_color.description: Fog color, as an RGB integer.

foliage_color.description: Optional foliage color override, as an RGB integer.

grass_color.description: Optional grass color override, as an RGB integer.

id.description: Identity used in world generators and biome conditions.

precipitation.description: Whether the biome has rain or snow. Defaults to true.

sky_color.description: Sky color, as an RGB integer.

spawn_costs.description: Optional population-density budget and charge for each entity.

spawners.description: Natural spawn entries in authored order within each vanilla category.

water_color.description: Water surface color, as an RGB integer.

water_fog_color.description: Underwater fog color, as an RGB integer.
